sn8.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhu-saṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhu-satehi sattahi ca upāsaka-satehi sattahi ca upāsika-satehi anekehi ca devatā-sahassehi ||
sn8.11:1.2: tyāssudaṃ Bhagavā atirocati vaṇṇena c-eva yasasā ca || || 2.
sn8.11:1.3: Atha kho āyasmato Vaṅgīsassa etad ahosi || ||
sn8.11:1.4: Ayaṃ kho Bhagavā Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre mahatā bhikkhu-saṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi sattahi ca upāsakasatehi sattahi ca upāsikasattehi anekehi ca devatā-sahassehi ||
sn8.11:1.5: tyāssudaṃ Bhagavā atirocati vaṇṇena c-eva yasasā ca || ||
sn8.11:1.6: Yaṃ nūnāhaṃ Bhagavantaṃ sammukkā sarūpāya gāthāya abhitthaveyyanti || || 3.
sn8.11:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Vaṅgiso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā ten-añjalim paṇāmetvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn8.11:2.2: Paṭibhāti maṃ Bhagavā paṭibhāti maṃ Sugatā ti || || 4.
sn8.11:2.3: Paṭibhātu taṃ Vaṅgisā ti Bhagavā avoca || || 5.
sn8.11:2.4: Atha kho āyasmā Vaṅgiso Bhagavato sammukhā sarūpāya gāthāya abhitthavi || ||
